fixes: Explicit option_id/text pairs in model inputs.
Distinct other claims no longer merge solely because frames/roles/time match.
Observations exclude options and record visible actions rather than option purposes.
Batch per-window verification with independent per-candidate schema, temporal/source checks and actual prompt provenance.
Defer overview assessments until temporal checkpoints are observed.
Gate has chronological caption context for contradiction checks, but captions cannot serve as verified facts.
Gate distinguishes direct contradiction from non-observation; non-observation cannot pass proof.
Final full-timeline answer can correct gate candidate; conflicts downgrade sufficient status.
Decision projection keeps all fact descriptions, roles, intervals, sources and unique verifier findings while omitting repeated proof histories.
Exact token fitting also applies to the gate, preserving every verified fact.
Observed_at schema allows only actual source times or null. A real LMFE regression verifies frame indices are rejected before generation.

lessons: Label each answer option adjacent to its text.
Read retained chronological descriptions for the overall activity.
Avoid treating isolated actions as the whole-video objective.

Fixed-evidence answer recheck isolates the decision path and does not test new observations.
